title: Energising Start I - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Energising Start I in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Energising Start I is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: +1 AP on battle start.

sections.title: How to Get Energising Start I
Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
